requirements.rule: DAILY ROTATING SHIFT ALLOWANCES (Art. 61(c), p. 91): EUR 4.50 per counted actual service day for eligible staff stably rotating across three shifts, or EUR 2.06 for eligible staff stably alternating scheduled morning and afternoon shifts; these rates are mutually exclusive. Caller-stated roles assert both the qualifying profile and stable monthly rotation; night-hour facts do not establish either. The PDF cover prints 8 October 2020 and Art. 4 makes effects start the following day, 9 October 2020.
requirements.remediation: Caller must verify qualifying profile, scheduled service and stable monthly rotation before stating a rotation role; no automatic inference from night hours. The engine does not independently verify qualifying roles or stable rotation.

requirements.rule: ENTERPRISE ON-CALL ADOPTION AND COVERED PROFILES (Art. 60, p. 89): enterprise-level evaluation and regulation, after consultation, defines the profiles involved. The caller asserts the enterprise has adopted the service and the worker is covered by submitting on-call events; the engine does not verify the enterprise agreement or profile eligibility.
requirements.remediation: Verify the enterprise-level adoption and covered profiles before submitting on-call events; add qualifying facts if automated validation is needed.

requirements.rule: Art. 56 freezes the worker's RIA balance acquired by 31 December 1993; maximum_count=0 stops new accrual but does not provide the balance. Supply the actual preserved monthly balance as IndividualElement(code='frozen_ria', monthly=<worker balance>, absorbable=False, as_of=None, extra_months=True, tfr_relevant=True). It is paid monthly and included in the Art. 58 daily/hourly base and Art. 66 thirteenth; Art. 73 applies the ordinary TFR base. No national amount is specified.
requirements.remediation: Require the worker's actual frozen monthly RIA balance as an individual element; without that fact, no historical amount can be inferred.

requirements.rule: A parental leave by the hour takes half the average daily hours a day and counts two such days as one day of leave, the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter D.Lgs. 151/2001 (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.2), which also excludes its cumulation with the nursing rests on the same day. A national CCNL rule that sets other hours to a day of leave prevails (art. 32 c. 1-bis): the run records this limitation while the bundle does not record the rule of the CCNL (work_rules.parental_hourly) or the rule sets its own hours, which the engine does not apply yet; a company or territorial agreement is the fact local_hourly_agreement of the event.
requirements.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: SHIFT AND RISK ALLOWANCES (Arts. 60-61, pp. 90-91): night hours between 22:00 and 06:00 and on-call turns of 4 to 12 hours are paid from event facts. Holiday shifts (€17.82 above half the scheduled shift, €8.91 for at most half with at least two hours) remain unmodelled: scheduled shift length, night-holiday overlap and the one-per-holiday-day cap are not captured. Radiation risk (€1,239.50 annually) requires category A or medical radiology technician status and actual service time. On-call interventions, compensatory rest and the usual eight-day monthly limit are not inferred from standby turns. The source does not settle whether on-call pay enters the TFR base; the current non-TFR treatment needs independent verification.
requirements.remediation: Supply scheduled holiday shift duration, eligibility and radiation service facts and apply the holiday cap, night overlap, compensatory rest and on-call intervention rules before paying the remaining allowances.

requirements.rule: CCNL applied in ultrattività; Decreto Lavoro 2026 introduced a statutory 30% IPCA auto-adjustment if no renewal within 12 months of expiry. If triggered, legally applicable 2026 minimums may exceed the 2020 Tabella 1 values modelled here. Engine models contractual tables only.
requirements.remediation: Verify whether the statutory IPCA adjustment applies to T011 under ultrattività and model it, or record the limitation.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid none, its treatment not being sourced.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.
